title: Black Butler — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
The honest version of Black Butler starts by giving up the comforting part. Black Butler (Japanese: 黒執事, Hepburn: Kuroshitsuji) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yana Toboso. The series follows Ciel Phantomhive, the 12-year-old Earl of Phantomhive serving as the Queen's Watchdog.

Every serious account of Black Butler eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. The rest of the roles were re-cast, with Taketo Tanaka replacing Yukito Nishii as Ciel Phantomhive, and Shinji Rachi and Masataka Nakagauchi replacing Taisuke Saeki and Matsumoto Shinya in the roles of Eric Slingby and Alan Humphries. A third musical Lycoris that Blazes the Earth (地に燃えるリコリス, Chi ni Moeru Lycoris) was performed in September 2014.

scenes.narration: The honest version of Black Butler starts by giving up the comforting part. Black Butler (Japanese: 黒執事, Hepburn:
Kuroshitsuji) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yana Toboso. The series follows Ciel Phantomhive, the
12-year-old Earl of Phantomhive serving as the Queen's Watchdog. Strip Black Butler of its poetry and the mechanism
underneath is stranger. Ciel has formed a contract with demon Sebastian Michaelis, who disguises himself as his butler,
to seek revenge on those who tortured him and murdered his parents. In exchange for his services, Sebastian
will be allowed to consume Ciel's soul. Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Black Butler shows exactly
where that breaks. A 24-episode anime television
